newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight activity subdued.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight activity subdued.

text.p: London sugar freight activity was more subdued on Tuesday after a brisk start to the week. No fixtures were reported.
Kerry Trading 12,000 Thailand to Surabaya prompt, 12,000 bagged South China, Pakistan or Red Sea prompt.
Cargill 25,000 bulk Santos to Baltic, Black Sea or Med for 24-28 July.
Dreyfus 15,200 to 16,800 South Brazil to Black Sea prompt.
Noble 14,000 bagged Santos to Indian Ocean or Red Sea prompt.
Jean Lion 14,000 bagged continent to Um Qasr prompt.
Benham 12,000 to 15,500 bagged Manzanillo to Peru 2nd half July.
